page.layout: One page of running text, a woodcut ornament below it, the catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: præsentia & imminentia, hæresium, bellorum, famis, pestilentiæ, & alia pericula, ut colligi & foveri cœtus docentium & discentium, ac propagari doctrinarum studia possint: serva inter nos & in hac dilectissima patria nostra Ecclesiam te rectè agnoscentem & invocatem, & fac nos omnes vasa misericordiæ tuæ, salutaria nobis & aliis, ut te cum Filio tuo & Spiritu sancto in æternum celebremus.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (fleuron) centred below the text, not transcribed. The faint mirrored text in the margins and at the right edge is show-through and was left out. The catchword "ORA-" is at the lower right and begins the next page.
